items.title: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
items.summary_zh: CarryOn将长程智能体上下文从交互历史改为围绕可复用任务对象组织，通过跨折叠维护载体记录并按证据与环境检查修订受影响记录，保留未受影响记录并更新执行上下文；在OSWorld 2.0和BrowseComp-Plus上分别提升5.8%和7.0%，总token用量分别减少51.9%和22.9%。
items.summary_en: CarryOn moves long-horizon agent context from interaction history to reusable task objects, maintains carrier records across folds, revises affected records via evidence and environment checks, retains unaffected records, and updates execution context; OSWorld 2.0/BrowseComp-Plus improve 5.8%/7.0%, with total token usage down 51.9%/22.9%.

items.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
items.summary_zh: HexaShell 以薄封装改进 VLM 编码智能体控制机器人的方式：仅把经命令行发出的命令转成双臂动作，并让智能体在失败后读日志、编写基于 triangulation 的工具；在 42 个 RoboDojo 任务上，作者称取得 39.7% 成功率和 48.0 进度分，达到新的 state of the art。
items.summary_en: HexaShell, a thin wrapper, improves VLM-coded agents' robot control: it converts command-line commands into dual-arm actions and lets agents read logs after failures and write triangulation-based tools; on 42 RoboDojo tasks, authors report 39.7% success and 48.0 progress, new state of the art.

held_out.quote: test them on ten new layouts of the same seed

code_released.quote: We open source the tools evolved so far

items.title: Socratic Skill Learning: Interleaving Teaching and Practice for Transferable Agent Skills
items.summary_zh: 提出 Socratic Skill Learning（SSL），将专家教学与学生实操交错进行，学生始终是唯一的环境操作者与 Skill 作者，可提问、测试并改写建议，从而学到可迁移的智能体技能；Issue-Guided SSL 在主队列上达到 0.805 utility，比 Fixed-Window SSL 少用 61.7% 的 Educator tokens 和 16.9% 的总获取 tokens。
items.summary_en: Socratic Skill Learning (SSL) interleaves expert teaching, student practice; student remains sole environment operator, Skill author, questioning, testing, and revising suggestions for transferable agent skills. Issue-Guided SSL achieves 0.805 main-queue utility, with 61.7% fewer Educator tokens and 16.9% fewer total acquisition tokens than Fixed-Window SSL.

held_out.quote: held-out evaluation in fresh solver sessions

cross_model.quote: Across three model pairs on shared families

items.title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
items.summary_zh: MemPilot 改进性能–成本–延迟偏好下的按需记忆整理，用强化学习优化多步 LLM 策略，在检索 query-agnostic 记忆与委托异构 LLM/VLM 按查询整理多模态历史间选择，并控制证据量、指令、模型与视觉访问；在五个多模态 agent-memory 基准上，偏好扫描的前沿宽于现有 trade-off-aware 基线。
items.summary_en: MemPilot improves on-demand memory organization under performance–cost–latency preferences via reinforcement learning optimizing multi-step LLM policy: retrieve query-agnostic memory or delegate heterogeneous LLM/VLM for query-wise multimodal history organization, controlling evidence amount, instruction, model, visual access; five multimodal agent-memory benchmarks: preference-sweep frontier wider than existing trade-off-aware baselines.

items.title: From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents: Self-Evolving Harnesses for History-Dependent Manipulation
items.short_title: From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents
items.summary_zh: 将高层VLM规划器组织为带可编辑harness的机器人智能体，用观测与执行反馈维护任务上下文，并通过环境推演自我进化harness以应对历史依赖操作；在RoboMME上，SERA自主选择配置达到51.38%总体成功率，无自我进化时为44.38%。
items.summary_en: Organize a high-level VLM planner as a robotic agent with an editable harness, maintain task context via observations and execution feedback, and self-evolve the harness through environment rollouts for history-dependent operations; on RoboMME, SERA autonomously selects configurations achieving 51.38% overall success, versus 44.38% without self-evolution.

items.title: EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents
items.summary_zh: EAU 让用户模拟器、环境与智能体在多轮强化学习训练中协同演化，通过监测轨迹并热替换针对性修改来改进用户模拟器、环境和奖励设置；在基准和模型上，总体得分较最强基线提高 14.7--15.0%，ColBench 成功任务完成率最多提高 36.7%。
items.summary_en: EAU co-evolves user simulators, environments, and agents in multi-turn RL training, monitoring trajectories and hot-swapping targeted modifications to improve simulators, environments, and reward settings; across benchmarks/models, overall scores rise 14.7--15.0% vs. strongest baseline, and ColBench successful task completion rate rises up to 36.7%.

items.title: EvalResearchBench: Can AI Agents Build Their Own Feedback for Recursive Self-Improvement?
items.summary_zh: EvalResearchBench 将 RSI 中设计评测器的过程交给 AI agent：给定目标材料、参考、候选 API 和固定预算，researcher 选择或合成任务、实现并试点修订 grader，再冻结可执行评测器。结果显示最佳评测器的候选对排序接近目标基准，但低于目标基准间分歧设定的上限，且开发目标上的最佳评测器并非密封目标上的最佳。
items.summary_en: EvalResearchBench assigns RSI evaluator design to an AI agent: given target materials, references, candidate API, fixed budget, researcher selects/synthesizes tasks, implements/pilot-revises grader, freezes executable evaluator. Best evaluator’s candidate-pair ranking nears target benchmark but stays below target-benchmark-disagreement upper bound; development-target best is not sealed-target best.

held_out.quote: sealed targets hidden from the researcher

items.title: VIEWCRAFT: Evolving What Multimodal Agents See and How They Read It
items.summary_zh: ViewCraft 联合演化可执行证据接口与其阅读过程，用失败轨迹指导修订、重放和配对评估保留有效改动，在八个基准上平均比 direct execution 提升 6.1 points，且每个基准都有增益。
items.summary_en: ViewCraft jointly evolves executable evidence interfaces and their reading process, uses failure trajectories to guide revision, replay, and paired evaluation to retain effective changes, and improves by an average of 6.1 points over direct execution on eight benchmarks, with gains on every benchmark.

matched_budget.quote: The advantage persists at a matched input-token budget.

cross_model.quote: The learned skills also transfer across executors

items.title: SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm
items.summary_zh: 提出 SwarmRSI 框架，用 Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation 依据其他智能体的实验反馈修正假设及其实现，并用 Complementary Swarm Recombination 复用保留的假设与互补程序组件，由 Recursive Swarm Evolution 将两者整合为反馈回路；在 OpenProblems、NatureBench 与 MLE-Bench Lite 上取得 SOTA 表现。
items.summary_en: We propose SwarmRSI framework: Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation revises hypotheses and implementations via other agents' experimental feedback; Complementary Swarm Recombination reuses retained hypotheses and complementary program components; Recursive Swarm Evolution integrates both into a feedback loop. Achieves SOTA on OpenProblems, NatureBench, and MLE-Bench Lite.

items.title: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research
items.summary_zh: Épi 借助持久研究历史、分层记忆、分支与独立评审及固定验证器，让自主研究智能体跨会话延续实验并从积累的经验中改进方法；作者称其产出 120 项创纪录结果，例如将 n-queens 常数的区间收窄约 84 倍。
items.summary_en: Épi uses persistent research history, hierarchical memory, branching and independent review, and a fixed verifier to let autonomous research agents continue experiments across sessions and improve methods from accumulated experience. The authors report 120 record results, e.g., narrowing the n-queens constant interval by about 84-fold.

matched_budget.quote: using the same underlying model and reasoning effort

items.title: Which Agent's Skill Should Change? Group-Relative Credit Assignment for Evolving Multi-Agent Teams
items.short_title: Which Agent's Skill Should Change? Group-Relative Credit Assignment for Evolving Multi-Agent Teams
items.summary_zh: GRSE（Group-Relative Skill Evolution）在同一技能库下多次执行每个问题，通过对比执行结果把团队奖励归因到 agent-skill 对，并诊断失败；它在 HotpotQA 和除 open-domain 外的所有 LoCoMo 类别上优于 MASkills，多跳问题增益最大（+6.7 和 +3.2 F1）。
items.summary_en: GRSE (Group-Relative Skill Evolution) executes each problem multiple times under one skill library, attributing team reward to agent-skill pairs via execution-result comparison and failure diagnosis; it beats MASkills on HotpotQA and all LoCoMo categories except open-domain, with largest multi-hop gains (+6.7 and +3.2 F1).

items.title: DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses
items.summary_zh: DiscoveryRSI 改进从研究过程学习有价值假设的方式，通过多智能体演化搜索构建假设树、把研究方案编译为可执行 Harbor 任务并递归学习，其 DiscoveryRSI-27B 的假设与模型截止后发表研究的对应率达到 6.3%，高于 GPT-6 Luna 的 2.5% 和 Claude Opus 5 的 2.3%。
items.summary_en: DiscoveryRSI improves learning valuable hypotheses from the research process via multi-agent evolutionary search: building a hypothesis tree, compiling research plans into executable Harbor tasks, and recursive learning. DiscoveryRSI-27B's hypotheses match post-cutoff published research at 6.3%, above GPT-6 Luna's 2.5% and Claude Opus 5's 2.3%.

held_out.quote: research published after the model cutoff

items.title: Δτ-Bench: Pushing Agents Toward a Moving Capability
items.summary_zh: 提出可执行智能体基准 Δτ-Bench，用 42 个领域、1,588 个多轮任务和连续生态系统状态模拟工具生态的结构演化，评估智能体主动发现高效工具路径并及时修正程序性知识的能力，作者报告最强受评模型或框架仅达 42.3% 任务成功率。
items.summary_en: We introduce Δτ-Bench, an executable agent benchmark with 42 domains, 1,588 multi-turn tasks, and continuous ecosystem-state simulation of tool-ecosystem structural evolution, evaluating agents' ability to discover efficient tool paths and revise procedural knowledge; the strongest evaluated model or framework reached only 42.3% task success.

items.title: FlowState: Execution State as Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
items.summary_zh: FlowState 将执行状态作为可跨请求保留与回溯的记忆，通过 Incremental State Update 维护当前状态、由 Progressive State Access 按需展开历史状态与证据。与使用同一 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 模型的全上下文基线相比，它在 τ^3-Bench 上的平均通过率提升 13.95 个百分点，总 token 消耗降低 40.6%。
items.summary_en: FlowState keeps execution state as cross-request retained/traceable memory; Incremental State Update maintains current state, Progressive State Access unfolds historical states/evidence on demand. Versus full-context baseline with same DeepSeek-V4-Flash model, raises τ^3-Bench average pass rate by 13.95 percentage points and cuts total token use by 40.6%.

items.title: CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance
items.summary_zh: CarryOn 通过规划环持续维护并更新用户与场景上下文、执行环监督动作并在失败时调用可复用恢复技能，来增强冻结的 VLA 策略；在真实机器人和仿真中，它将已安全微调 VLA 的违规率从 52.6% 降至 6.1%。
items.summary_en: CarryOn enhances a frozen VLA policy: a planning loop maintains and updates user and scene context; an execution loop monitors actions and calls reusable recovery skills on failure. In real robots and simulation, it cuts a safely fine-tuned VLA's violation rate from 52.6% to 6.1%.

items.title: Remembering Has a Price: Learning Memory Worth under Resource Constraints
items.summary_zh: 为应对资源受限下现有终身记忆方法效果有限的问题，提出轻量在线记忆框架 TokenWorth，从稀疏执行反馈学习依赖查询的记忆价值并用于检索与有界记忆管理；在三个 LifelongAgentBench 环境及本地与 API 部署中，其任务成功率最高且输出 token 最少。
items.summary_en: TokenWorth, a lightweight online memory framework, learns query-dependent memory value from sparse execution feedback for retrieval and bounded memory management, addressing limited lifelong-memory effectiveness under resource constraints; across three LifelongAgentBench environments and local and API deployments, achieving highest task success rate with fewest output tokens.

items.title: Continual Learning Exam: Benchmarking Long-Horizon RSI and Experiential Learning in LLM Agents
items.summary_zh: 针对LLM智能体评估多只看单任务表现，作者构建含120个任务、五级阶梯共600个层级的Continual Learning Exam (CLE)，并比较失败后诊断反馈加一次修订的设置；在17种配置中该设置带来5.3个百分点的完成率中位提升，但最佳系统仅通过47.7%的层级。
items.summary_en: LLM agent evaluation often only assesses single-task performance; authors built Continual Learning Exam (CLE): 120 tasks, five levels, 600 tiers, comparing after-failure diagnostic feedback plus one revision. Across 17 configurations, this gave median completion-rate gain 5.3 percentage points, but best system passed 47.7% of tiers.

items.title: DuoDiscover: Scaling Autonomous Discovery Beyond the Evaluation Bottleneck
items.summary_zh: DuoDiscover 让编码智能体群各自协同发现优化目标与快速代理评估器 yardstick，并以保真度测试剔除漂移的代理，绕开真实评估昂贵的瓶颈。在评估耗时长达 28 hours 的 CPU 微架构优化任务上，作者称其 16.7 days 内超过 AlphaEvolve-based ArchAgent v2 与最佳人类设计，增益达 ArchAgent v2 的 1.65times。
items.summary_en: DuoDiscover lets agent swarms co-discover optimization objectives and fast proxy yardsticks; fidelity tests remove drifting proxies, bypassing costly real evaluation. On CPU microarchitecture optimization (28 hours), authors claim it surpasses AlphaEvolve-based ArchAgent v2 and best human designs in 16.7 days, 1.65times gain over ArchAgent v2.

items.title: TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents
items.summary_zh: 提出外部控制器 TokenEconomizer，通过选择注入的操作微技能、剪除持续无关的工具并判断何时干预无效失败循环，降低连续编码任务中的 token 成本，在 Claude Code、Codex 与 GitHub Copilot CLI 上平均减少 18.4-30.9% 的 token 成本而任务成功率相当。
items.summary_en: External controller TokenEconomizer selects injected operational micro-skills, prunes persistently irrelevant tools, and decides when to intervene in ineffective failure loops, reducing token cost in continuous coding tasks. On Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, it cuts it by 18.4-30.9% on average with comparable task success.

cross_model.quote: Across Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot CLI

items.title: Trustworthy Recursive Self-Improvement in the Era of Large Models: Foundation, Risks, Evaluation and Open Challenges
items.short_title: Trustworthy Recursive Self-Improvement in the Era of Large Models
items.summary_zh: 这篇综述为 RSI 提出操作定义与过程框架，把可信 RSI 的要求归入四个相互关联主题，并从 Improvement Validity、Constraint Preservation 和 Effective Oversight 三个视角分析 S1--S4 与 RI 的风险、防护和评估证据；它还区分直接 RSI 发现与相关系统证据，并提出独立和纵向评估的要求。
items.summary_en: Review proposes operational definition and process framework for RSI, grouping trustworthy-RSI requirements into four interrelated themes. It analyzes risks, safeguards, evaluation evidence for S1--S4 and RI across Improvement Validity, Constraint Preservation, Effective Oversight; distinguishes direct RSI findings from related system evidence; requires independent, longitudinal evaluation.

items.title: JockeyBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Horse-Racing Decision-Making
items.summary_zh: JockeyBench 以日本赛马历史数据构建基准，用时间门控证据和配对冻结程序对照，分别评估预测质量、净效用及固定规则下的投注收益与风险；在 324 场比赛的 28 种模型-scaffold 配置中，在 capped-Kelly 结算下，所有配置的平均利润均为负。
items.summary_en: JockeyBench builds a benchmark from Japanese horse-racing historical data, using time-gated evidence and paired frozen-procedure controls to separately assess prediction quality, net utility, and fixed-rule betting returns and risk; across 28 model-scaffold configurations on 324 races under capped-Kelly settlement, all average profits were negative.

items.title: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries
items.summary_zh: Librarian Agents 让 builder agent 把原始文档组织成含合成文件与引用链接的层级文件系统，并用强化学习优化构建策略以提升下游答题准确率；在 BrowseComp-Plus 上比最强检索与预计算基线高 33 个百分点。
items.summary_en: Librarian Agents have a builder agent organize raw documents into a hierarchical file system with synthesized files and citation links, using reinforcement learning to optimize construction for better downstream QA accuracy; on BrowseComp-Plus it beats the strongest retrieval and precomputation baselines by 33 percentage points.

held_out.quote: generalizes zero-shot to unseen domains on BRIGHT

items.title: Unsupervised Tool Evolution for Coding Agents in Data-Lake Analytics
items.short_title: Unsupervised Tool Evolution for Coding Agents in Data-Lake Analytics
items.summary_zh: 提出无监督工具演化方法 TEAL，由 Explorer 从数据湖、Critic 从 Worker 轨迹提议工具，仅当 Worker 重跑时无需额外步骤即采用且答案有轨迹证据支持才保留，在 KramaBench 与 LakeQA 上评估；15 步预算下使 Sonnet-5 分别提升 9.3 点和 21.7 点。
items.summary_en: TEAL, unsupervised tool evolution: Explorer proposes tools from data lake and Critic from Worker trajectories; keep only if Worker adopts it on rerun without extra steps and answers have trajectory evidence. On KramaBench and LakeQA, 15-step budget improves Sonnet-5 by 9.3 and 21.7 points, respectively.

matched_budget.quote: lifting Sonnet-5 at 15 steps by 9.3 points

items.title: Co-adaptive Rule Routing and Constraining for Structured Knowledge Retrieval
items.short_title: Co-adaptive Rule Routing and Constraining for Structured Knowledge Retrieval
items.summary_zh: CoRE 在无预定义查询-规则对的情况下联合学习为每个查询分配推理规则并在该规则约束下检索证据，通过路由策略的强化学习与规则约束检索器的对比学习交替共适应，在 STaRK-QA 数据集上验证了有效性。
items.summary_en: CoRE jointly learns, without predefined query-rule pairs, to assign a reasoning rule to each query and retrieve evidence under that rule's constraints, alternating co-adaptation via reinforcement learning of a routing policy and contrastive learning of a rule-constrained retriever, validated on STaRK-QA dataset.

items.title: Skill^{infty}: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Skill Optimization
items.summary_zh: Skill^{infty} 把技能优化做成递归自我改进，meta agent 按 meta-skill 优化任务技能，并用同一流程改写 meta-skill 本身，该 meta-skill 与任务技能解耦、可在多个任务上精炼后跨域复用；在 83 个 SkillsBench 任务上通过率为 60.7%，高于人工整理技能的 56.4% 和 SkillEvolver 的 54.5%。
items.summary_en: Skill^{infty} makes skill optimization recursive self-improvement: meta agent optimizes task skills via meta-skill and rewrites meta-skill itself by the same process; decoupled from task skills, refined on multiple tasks and cross-domain reused. On 83 SkillsBench tasks, pass rate 60.7% vs human-curated 56.4% and SkillEvolver 54.5%.
